state.seed_assertion: A multimeter must be set to the proper range and function before testing.

sentences.1: Software faults tend to be repeatable and occur when a specific set of conditions is present, whereas hardware faults are affected by environmental conditions.
sentences.2: A software fault may seem intermittent, but normally this is because a very specific set of conditions needs to be present to cause the fault.
sentences.3: A standard multimeter samples far too slowly to catch a micro-second voltage spike.
sentences.4: Even some high-end oscilloscopes might miss a disruptive event if the trigger isn't set perfectly.
